name: @shotlyx/client
description: Desktop video editor and local agent workspace for Shotlyx.
author: GuanTou Lab

scripts.pack:unsigned: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: node scripts/require-mac-notarization-env.mjs && bun run build && electron-builder --publish never && node scripts/verify-mac-release.mjs
scripts.dist:all: node scripts/require-mac-notarization-env.mjs && bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-mac-release.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/require-mac-notarization-env.mjs && bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never && node scripts/verify-mac-release.mjs
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:win: bun run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.publish:mac: node scripts/require-mac-notarization-env.mjs && bun run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish always && node scripts/verify-mac-release.mjs
scripts.publish:win: bun run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish always
